card.name: Yangko
card.tagline: Alternate romanization of Yangge, the rice-sprout folk dance
card.profile: Yangko is an alternate romanization of Yangge (秧歌), the traditional northern Chinese 'rice-sprout song' folk dance created by farmers in the Song dynasty to pray for harvest (Easy Tour China; English Wikipedia). The dance is smooth and compact in rhythm, with three performance types: song-and-dance duets, ground yangko and stilt yangko, using colorful theatrical-style costumes and silk handkerchiefs.
card.insight: As the best-known Han folk dance, Yangko/Yangge represents communal celebration, abundance and fertility and continues year-round in Chinese countryside and cities (Easy Tour China; English Wikipedia).
